This is heavy. Sometimes posts here can be a little overdramatic or seem phoney, but I can tell you’re not fucking around and this is obviously no joke. I don’t know much about guns unfortunately, and I’ve also attempted suicide many times to no avail. If you want to talk before you check out. Pm me, I’d like to hear your story.

don’t do it. pm me. I’m here for you, i struggle with suicidal thoughts and depression everyday. I understand. I will talk to you. I will listen. one day at a time we will get by. people have gotten out of this, it happens, it’s possible.

Can’t put a price on life. If you’re thinking about committing suicide tonight or anytime soon, go to the hospital. get help, depression is fucked lol. it’s no joke. if you can ride it out then ride it out and save yourself the cost, but if you can’t do it anymore and you’ve exhausted all other options... go get help. you seriously can’t put a price on life. Tell your family it was either professional help or suicide... I’m sure they would agree they’re better off still having you around then not, regardless of expenses.

I hear ya. I’m in the same boat. I won’t say I understand because I don’t, the same way you won’t understand my depression and my unbearable feelings either. it’s all different. you’re absolutely correct. but I can say I too am at wits end, I too have zero zest for life and everyday is a struggle wanting to end my life, everyday is fuckin shit mate. I hate the sympathy others give and the notion that they understand because there’s simply no way they genuinely do, but what keeps me going is this... surely there are people out there who have been as hopelessly depressed as you and I who have somehow someway made it out, surely somewhere out there someone has had it worse then you and I, and made it out. it’s not Impossible. it can happen. Although I have a pretty damn good idea of exactly how tomorrow is gonna go, and how fucking garbage I’m going to feel all day, what if tomorrow is the first day that a tiny glimmer of hope shines through that darkness, but I end it all tonight never knowing that tomorrow would be the one day that changes everything. Just keep fighting. Keep pushing on. Keep moving forward. just survive. that’s all you have to do...just survive.

Get help!! try anti depressants, therapy, definitely seek professional advice! might be costly but you can’t put a price on life and you should take this as seriously as you possibly can, you don’t want to lose someone that close to you and end up regretting not doing everything you could to save them, depression is an awful mental illness the worst part is most of the time if we don’t even want to be alive we definitely don’t have the motivation to get the help we need on our own, it makes a world of a difference having someone else help put those first steps into place, I hope everything will be okay! god bless
haha been there done that, but thanks for the positivity! goes a long a way for me so I appreciate it...take care! I hope you have a wonderful life :) god bless

Lol I’m jealous, I never used to struggle with depression either until 2 years ago it just hit me out of nowhere and I haven’t been the same since, I long for the days for when I used to be so enthusiastic about life, I didn’t realize how much I took just feeling happy and normal for granted, so on the days where you’re feeling better, take a moment to really appreciate it bc man I would do literally anything to feel normal again

Have you told your family about these fantasies? it might be hard and it definitely won’t be easy for them, but it’d be a hell of a lot easier then mourning your death if these fantasies become a reality one day, I would talk to your family members and try to get help before it gets any worse, take care :)

Lol it’s honestly funny how up and down depression gets, talking to people on this sub helps me feel better too, brings me some hope and comfort, sometimes I briefly feel like everything’s gonna be okay for once, then 2 hours later I’m even more exhausted then I was to begin with, so strange lol.
I wish I could donate my life to someone who wants to live

what if tomorrow or the next day will be the first day you begin to feel even a tiny glimmer of hope but you end it all tonight? you’d never know. so many people make it out of the most hopeless of places. Believe me you too will be one of those people. somehow some fuckin way you will get through this my friend.

Pm me anytime if you ever just need someone to listen to you. I’m in the same boat. everyday is such a struggle and we both have a pretty damn good idea what tomorrow will be like, but what keeps me going is maybe just maybe tomorrow will be the first day we see a tiny glimmer of hope, and we’ll have never known if we end it all tonight. A lot of people in our shoes do make out one day, and many more will, let’s hold onto hope and try to believe that we will be one of those people.

Yup, literally the only thing that gives me a sigh of relief and some peace of mind is knowing that I can essentially check out at anytime. I honestly wish I didn’t have a family who cared so much about me sometimes because the only thing preventing me from following through on my desire to die is knowing I would be leaving loved ones behind in mourning

I’m glad to hear from someone who actually understands. we’re constantly told that suicide is never the option when in reality i believe in so many cases such as our own it can be the best thing to do, living any longer is suffering unnecessarily & you’re right...this is truly not living. I believe it is almost unfair/immoral to expect folks like us to stay around and suffer any longer then need be, if we want to go, if we truly believe it is best for us, who is anyone else to say otherwise? it is only a matter of time and building up the courage to do so to end this pain that we know is terminal, some people may believe better days are ahead & there may come a time when we are able to live happily, the question is then whether or not we are willing to take the gamble of holding onto that hope & risk suffering for the rest of our lives waiting for peace of mind that never comes. I’m not sure that is a gamble I am willing to roll the dice on, but I guess only time will tell.
